extracted.name: Red Sangria
extracted.description: Learn how to make red sangria at home! This Spanish wine punch is perfect for entertaining. Mix it up before a gathering and pop it in the fridge until you're ready to serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 Granny Smith or other green apple (cored and chopped)
1 orange (thinly sliced, then sliced into quarters)
⅓ cup raspberries or sliced strawberries
1 (750 mL) bottle Tempranillo, Garnacha, or Rioja wine
¼ to ½ cup Cointreau, Grand Marnier, or brandy
instruction_lines: Place the apple, orange, lime, and raspberries in a large pitcher. Pour in the wine, orange juice, and Cointreau and stir. Chill overnight (I like to chill mine for 24 hours for optimal fruit-infused flavor).
Serve in glasses filled with ice.
